# telnyx_integration_secret (Resource)

A secret that AI assistant tools send to your services, as a bearer token or a username and password. The API never returns the secret's value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_integration_secret" "example" {
  identifier = "crm_api"
  type       = "bearer"
  token      = var.crm_token
}

variable "crm_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) The unique identifier of the secret.
- `type` (String) The type of secret. One of `basic`, `bearer`. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password for the secret. Required for basic type secrets, ignored otherwise. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token for the secret. Required for bearer type secrets, ignored otherwise. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `username` (String) The username for the secret. Required for basic type secrets, ignored otherwise. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_integration_secret.example <id>
```
